name: Vercel Coding Agent Template
description: Vercel template web app that runs coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI in a sandbox against your repos.
whatItDoes: Users sign in, choose a repository and an agent, describe a task, and the app executes it in an isolated sandbox and pushes the changes to a branch. It is a base for self-hosted background coding agents.
howItWorks: A Next.js app with Postgres creates a Vercel Sandbox per task, clones the repository, runs the selected agent CLI inside it and streams logs. Authentication is via GitHub or Vercel OAuth, and MCP servers can be attached.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.description: Or per-agent keys such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, CURSOR_API_KEY

models: Depends on chosen agent: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode
